"""KinDER i00 driver and executed-action record.

The service episode is persistent. This file intentionally never replays the
history; append new executed chunks to ACTION_HISTORY after submitting them.
"""
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

ACTION_HISTORY = [
    {"label": "explore camera direction", "rows": 5, "action": "base_yaw=+0.1 each row"},
    {"label": "tilt wrist camera", "rows": 5, "action": "arm_6=+0.1 each row"},
    {"label": "search work area forward", "rows": 8, "action": "base_x=+0.08 each row"},
]

def connect():
    return Robot()

def observe(cameras=("robot_base", "robot_wrist"), depth=True):
    r = connect()
    print("STATUS", r.status())
    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=list(cameras), include_depth=depth, video="frames")
    obs.save("/app/output/current_observation")
    print("OBS", obs.meta)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    observe()
